reason: Backend error text is still English end to end; this records what exists so new strings fail.

deliberately_english.api.rs: Automation API answers a script in JSON, and three fields feed ApiRuntimeStatus.error, which the interface only tests for presence before showing its own mcp.bindFailed string. Nothing here is read by an operator as prose.
deliberately_english.store.rs: config_root fails only when the OS has no config directory, which is before there is a window to show a toast in.
deliberately_english.profile_icon.rs: ensure_icon has one caller, launch.rs, which logs the error with eprintln! and launches the profile anyway. The operator sees a missing icon, never the sentence.
